Homework 3 - Evaluation (10 Points)¶

Quantify the trained pix2pixHD using SSIM between the generated brightfield and the ground-truth brightfield. We compare four milestone checkpoints (5, 10, 20, 40) and probe the model with random binary masks it never saw during training.

In [3]:
import os, glob, subprocess, sys, random
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from skimage.metrics import structural_similarity as ssim
print("Libraries ready.")

Libraries ready.

1. Run inference on the test set¶

test.py writes results to pix2pixHD/results/<name>/test_<epoch>/images/. We use sys.executable so the subprocess uses the same Python (and dependencies) as the notebook kernel.

In [4]:
checkpoints_dir = "pix2pixHD/checkpoints"
results_dir     = "pix2pixHD/results"
dataroot        = "datasets/bbbc010_pix2pixhd"
name            = "bbbc010_512"
epochs          = [5, 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100]
N_TEST          = 20

for ep in epochs:
    out_folder = f"{results_dir}/{name}/test_{ep}"
    if os.path.exists(out_folder) and len(glob.glob(f"{out_folder}/images/*.jpg")) > 0:
        print(f"Epoch {ep} already inferred.")
        continue
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, "pix2pixHD/test.py",
        "--name", name,
        "--dataroot", dataroot,
        "--label_nc", "0",
        "--no_instance",
        "--loadSize", "512",
        "--fineSize", "512",
        "--which_epoch", str(ep),
        "--how_many", str(N_TEST),
        "--checkpoints_dir", checkpoints_dir,
        "--results_dir", results_dir,
    ]
    print(f"Running inference for epoch {ep} ...")
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(r.stdout[-2000:]); print(r.stderr[-2000:])
        raise RuntimeError(f"test.py failed at epoch {ep}")
print("All epochs ready.")

2. SSIM per epoch¶

For each milestone, compute SSIM between every generated image and its real ground-truth.

In [5]:
real_dir = "datasets/bbbc010_pix2pixhd/test_B"

def ssim_for_epoch(ep):
    res_dir = f"{results_dir}/{name}/test_{ep}/images"
    files = sorted(glob.glob(f"{res_dir}/*_synthesized_image.jpg"))
    vals = []
    for synth in files:
        base = os.path.basename(synth).replace("_synthesized_image.jpg", "")
        real = os.path.join(real_dir, base + ".png")
        if not os.path.exists(real): continue
        g = np.array(Image.open(synth)).astype(np.float32)
        r = np.array(Image.open(real)).astype(np.float32)
        # SSIM on luminance: average RGB channels, data_range=255 for uint8
        vals.append(ssim(g.mean(axis=2), r.mean(axis=2), data_range=255))
    return np.array(vals)

per_ep = {ep: ssim_for_epoch(ep) for ep in epochs}
print(f"{'epoch':>6} | {'mean':>6} | {'std':>6} | {'min':>6} | {'max':>6}")
print("-" * 42)
for ep in epochs:
    v = per_ep[ep]
    print(f"{ep:>6} | {v.mean():>6.3f} | {v.std():>6.3f} | {v.min():>6.3f} | {v.max():>6.3f}")

 epoch |   mean |    std |    min |    max
------------------------------------------
     5 |  0.613 |  0.012 |  0.594 |  0.633
    10 |  0.734 |  0.018 |  0.691 |  0.763
    20 |  0.809 |  0.020 |  0.778 |  0.856
    40 |  0.844 |  0.017 |  0.818 |  0.885
    60 |  0.844 |  0.024 |  0.786 |  0.884
    80 |  0.831 |  0.016 |  0.799 |  0.854
   100 |  0.845 |  0.017 |  0.797 |  0.867

Training loss curves¶

In [6]:
import re

log_path = "pix2pixHD/checkpoints/bbbc010_512/loss_log.txt"
loss_keys = ["G_GAN", "G_GAN_Feat", "G_VGG", "D_real", "D_fake"]
pattern = re.compile(
    r"\(epoch:\s*(\d+),.*?\)"
    + "".join(rf"\s+{k}:\s*([\d.]+)" for k in loss_keys)
)

# Keep last entry per epoch to handle training restarts
losses = {}
with open(log_path) as f:
    for line in f:
        m = pattern.search(line)
        if m:
            ep = int(m.group(1))
            losses[ep] = [float(m.group(i + 2)) for i in range(len(loss_keys))]

epochs_sorted = sorted(losses)
vals = {k: [losses[ep][i] for ep in epochs_sorted] for i, k in enumerate(loss_keys)}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4))

# Generator losses
for k in ["G_GAN", "G_GAN_Feat", "G_VGG"]:
    axes[0].plot(epochs_sorted, vals[k], label=k)
axes[0].set_title("Generator losses"); axes[0].set_xlabel("Epoch"); axes[0].set_ylabel("Loss")
axes[0].legend(); axes[0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# Discriminator losses
for k in ["D_real", "D_fake"]:
    axes[1].plot(epochs_sorted, vals[k], label=k)
axes[1].set_title("Discriminator losses"); axes[1].set_xlabel("Epoch")
axes[1].legend(); axes[1].grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle("pix2pixHD training losses across 100 epochs", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("loss_curves.png", dpi=120, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
In [7]:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(7, 4))
for ep in epochs:

ax.plot(epochs, [per_ep[ep].mean() for ep in epochs], "k-o", label="mean")
ax.set_xlabel("Epoch"); ax.set_ylabel("SSIM"); ax.set_title("SSIM across milestone epochs (higher → better)")

3. Side-by-side comparison¶

Pick the first test sample and show how its generation evolves across milestones. Optionally try a second sample.

In [ ]:
sample_base = None
for ep in epochs:
    f = sorted(glob.glob(f"{results_dir}/{name}/test_{ep}/images/*_synthesized_image.jpg"))
    if f: sample_base = os.path.basename(f[0]).replace("_synthesized_image.jpg", ""); break

DPI = 100
# Each source image is 512 px; at DPI=100 that's 5.12" per image.
# 3 columns + margins -> ~16.5" wide; 7 rows + title -> ~38" tall.
IMG_IN = 512 / DPI
fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(epochs), 3, figsize=(IMG_IN * 3 + 1, IMG_IN * len(epochs) + 1))

if sample_base is None:
    print("No results found.")
else:
    for row, ep in enumerate(epochs):
        rd = f"{results_dir}/{name}/test_{ep}/images"
        mask_p = f"{rd}/{sample_base}_input_label.jpg"
        gen_p  = f"{rd}/{sample_base}_synthesized_image.jpg"
        real_p = f"{real_dir}/{sample_base}.png"
        if not (os.path.exists(gen_p) and os.path.exists(real_p)):
            continue
        mask = np.array(Image.open(mask_p))
        gen  = np.array(Image.open(gen_p))
        real = np.array(Image.open(real_p))
        s = ssim(gen.mean(axis=2), real.mean(axis=2), data_range=255)
        axes[row, 0].imshow(mask); axes[row, 0].set_title("Mask")
        axes[row, 1].imshow(gen);  axes[row, 1].set_title(f"Epoch {ep}  (SSIM={s:.3f})")
        axes[row, 2].imshow(real); axes[row, 2].set_title("Real")
        for a in axes[row]: a.axis("off")
    plt.suptitle(f"Well {sample_base}", fontsize=13)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig("comparison_epochs.png", dpi=DPI, bbox_inches="tight")
    print(f"Saved comparison_epochs.png  ({DPI} dpi, ~512 px per image)")
    plt.show()

Saved comparison_epochs.png  (100 dpi, ~512 px per image)

4. Discussion¶

SSIM improves steeply through epoch 20 then plateaus near 0.844 from epoch 40 onward. Training losses (G_GAN, G_GAN_Feat, G_VGG) continue to fall after SSIM flattens, with a ~22 % drop between epochs 40 and 60 - reflecting texture refinement that SSIM cannot measure. After epoch 60 the internal worm structure becomes slightly more visible, while real images retain background spots (dust, noise) that the generator suppresses entirely.
